title: Boxz Instruct (seed set)
notes: 36 hand-written instruction/response pairs covering identity, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, debugging, Three.js, game design and ML basics. Written for this project (no third-party text), CC0. Used (a) as extra tokenizer coverage for code and chat markup and (b) as the seed set for instruction fine-tuning. It is small by design: SFT quality here is limited by scale and is documented as such.
allowed_use: Project original work, dedicated to the public domain.
